map.本工具依据 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 评分逐项累加评估非瓣膜性房颤卒中风险，并提: This tool sums CHA2DS2-VASc score to assess NVAF stroke risk and suggests balancing bleeding with HAS-BLED; calculation is local, data not uploaded, results for reference only, anticoagulation decided by doctor.
map.C — 充血性心衰/左室功能不全: C - Congestive heart failure / LV dysfunction
map.提示：女性单独的1分（Sc）不增加卒中风险，故女性0分和1分均不推荐OAC。瓣膜: Note: the lone female 1 point (Sc) does not raise stroke risk, so female 0 and 1 point both need no OAC. Valvular AF (moderate-severe mitral stenosis/mechanical valve) needs no scoring, all require warfarin. Assess HAS-BLED bleeding risk before anticoagulation. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：房颤 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 栓塞风险评估器: 📚 In-depth: AF CHA2DS2-VASc Thromboembolic Risk Assessor
map.CHA₂DS₂-VASc 评分累加：充血性心衰、高血压、年龄 ≥75（计 2）、: CHA2DS2-VASc scoring: CHF, hypertension, age >=75 (2), diabetes, stroke/TIA history (2), vascular disease, age 65-74, female each 1 point (0-9).
map.抗凝指征：男性 ≥2 分、女性 ≥3 分推荐口服抗凝；男性 1 分或女性 2 分: Anticoagulation indication: male >=2, female >=3 recommend OAC; male 1 or female 2 can be individualized; 0 (male)/1 (female) generally no anticoagulation.
map.出血风险权衡：启动抗凝前用 HAS-BLED 评估，高出血风险（≥3）并非停用抗: Bleeding risk: assess HAS-BLED before starting; high bleeding risk (>=3) does not mean stop anticoagulation but correct reversible factors (BP, INR, drugs).
map.输入：女、73 岁、高血压、无糖尿病、无卒中史、无心衰、无血管病。工具输出：CH: Input: female, 73, hypertension, no diabetes, no stroke history, no heart failure, no vascular disease. Output: CHA2DS2-VASc 3 (age 2 + hypertension 1), anticoagulation advice recommend oral anticoagulation (female >=3), HAS-BLED needs separate assessment, note monitor bleeding regularly. Note: specific drug (warfarin/DOAC) chosen by doctor with renal function and adherence.
map.为什么女性计分与男性不同？: Why do sex scores differ between male and female?
map.女性单独作为危险因素权重较低，指南将「单纯女性」从抗凝指征中剔除：男性 ≥2 分: The lone female as a risk factor has lower weight; guidelines remove 'female only' from the anticoagulation indication: male >=2, female >=3 recommend anticoagulation; male 1 or female 2 is a gray zone, decide individually after weighing benefit and bleeding.
map.可选华法林（需监测 INR 2.0–3.0）或新型口服抗凝药（DOAC，如达比加: Options: warfarin (monitor INR 2.0-3.0) or DOAC (e.g. dabigatran/rivaroxaban, by renal function). Choice depends on renal function, adherence, cost and bleeding history; do not switch or stop on your own.
map.抗凝后还要查什么？: What else to check after anticoagulation?
map.定期复查肾功能、血常规，关注黑便/血尿/牙龈出血等信号；合并用药（抗血小板、NS: Regularly review renal function and blood count, watch for black stool/hematuria/gum bleeding; combo drugs (antiplatelet, NSAID) need physician assessment. Even with high bleeding risk, prioritize controlling reversible factors rather than blindly stopping anticoagulation.
